title: Frame-Interpolation dep carries Impact Subpack's display name
description: Found 2026-08-28 while verifying node pins for MPI-649 and deliberately left there to keep that card's diff to the engine pin. js/data/modelConstants/nodesDeps.js:112 gives 'ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation' the name 'ComfyUI Impact Subpack', copy-pasted off the 'ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack' entry twenty lines below. `name` is the human label, so every surface that renders a dep - Model Library rows, the dependency and install-progress lists - shows two different packs under one name and the Frame Interpolation pack never appears under its own. Fix the label and sweep all 17 entries' `name` against their `id`/`filename` for the same clone slip.
